edition: 리버스콜 스포츠 · 클랜 시즌 4 결산 특별판

checks.mobile: 390×844 viewport/touch emulation; no real phone test

pdf.format: High-resolution newspaper facsimile; separate article text included

checks.visualReview: All six final PDF pages rendered by Poppler and inspected; desktop and mobile page captures inspected.

conditions.entry: Local index.html opened through file://, the delivered offline entry point
conditions.mobile: 390×844 touch viewport emulation; no physical phone measurement
conditions.network: No server or network dependency; local files
conditions.readyDefinition: Navigation invocation through document load, local fonts, viewport-visible image decode and two paint frames; controls installed.
conditions.firstLaunchDefinition: Fresh Chrome launch plus first navigation; OS file cache not forcibly cleared
conditions.baseline: Same article/layout, original source PNG, full TTF fonts, eager loading of every page image.
conditions.optimized: WebP cover; WOFF2 font subsets with renamed internal families; hidden images deferred and selected-page images loaded immediately.
conditions.frameScenario: Five user select changes and stepped scrolling; validation probes included
conditions.interpretation: Timing samples are local emulation results, not production network or phone measurements.

findings.resourceReduction: Initial requested local file bytes fell from 5,047,330 to 666,137 (86.8%); requests from 15 to 6.
findings.bottleneck: The offline reader has no server/network wait. Full Korean font and source illustration loading/decoding, plus browser-scheduled lazy image loading on first page change, were the avoidable costs addressed.
findings.timingLimit: Local cold/reentry timings varied. Do not claim a general first-entry speedup: desktop first navigation 321.6→340.3 ms and reentry 85.5→105.1 ms; mobile emulation 310.8→290.9 ms and 90.1→99.5 ms.
findings.interaction: Selected-page eager image loading reduced the observed first switch from 174.9/228.9 ms to 93.0/106.1 ms (desktop/mobile emulation in sequential runs). No main-thread long tasks were recorded; mobile had one >50 ms frame during first switching/loading.
findings.exit: No application intervals, timeouts or RAF loops scheduled. After navigating away, script duration increase was 0 ms over the sampled 500 ms.

scope: Standalone newspaper. No production database writes, reward delivery, game settings or public publishing.
